assignment.address: 330 N Grant Street, West Lafayette, Indiana

basis: Purdue GIS FID 799 is named Pi Kappa Phi and lists 330 N Grant.
The chapter's official website and Purdue BoilerLink independently identify the Omega chapter at 330 North Grant.
The chapter's official 2019 and 2023 photographs show the post-1987 rebuilt house at the same address.
source_crosswalk.footprint_confidence: high for footprint plan; converted from returned WGS84 polygon using the campus approximation in modular/AGENTS.md
source_crosswalk.facade_confidence: moderate for overall massing and material; low for exact dimensions and concealed details
source_crosswalk.orientation: West/front facade faces Grant Street, supported by the county BZA staff report describing the Grant Street setback as the west setback.

footprint_metrics.method: GIS polygon coordinates transformed with campus_xy approximation from modular/AGENTS.md. GIS Shape__Area and Shape__Length attributes were not used because they conflict with coordinate-derived planar measurements.
footprint_metrics.notes: Dimensions are approximate due to local coordinate approximation; roof overhangs and facade details extend beyond structural perimeter.

features: photo-guided multi-wing Tudor-inspired gabled roof composition
estimated pale ashlar stone facade joints and belt courses
photo-guided dark window openings, central dormers, and paired arched entrances

checks: Saved blend reopened in a new background Blender process.
All 239 scene objects are in the dedicated asset collection and are meshes; no camera/light/helper objects are included.
Evaluated world bounds are finite and match the recorded location/height.

visual_checks.inspection: Front preview visibly presents the west facade, paired arches, repeated windows, stone joint pattern, asymmetrical roof masses, and four dormers. Aerial preview shows the overall footprint-following massing and intersecting roof planes. Both are source-guided illustrations, not construction drawings.

lifecycle.decision: Model the extant house shown in 2019/2023 official photos.
lifecycle.proposal: A May 2026 BZA application sought variances for a planned tear-down and replacement at the same address; all six variances were approved May 27, 2026.
lifecycle.permit_status: unverified; no matching public permit record was retrieved in this review, and no inference of nonexistence is made.
lifecycle.latest_direct_use_evidence: Official chapter recruitment announcements identify house events at 330 N Grant on August 23-28, 2026; official homepage/archive contains September 2026 chapter activity.

remaining_uncertainty: Exact facade dimensions, floor-to-floor heights, and total building height have not been surveyed.
Some window spacing, dormer proportions, roof pitches, and unseen elevations remain photo-based estimates.
Permit status and any post-August facade alterations remain unverified.
